mapper.select: SELECT MENU_ID, UPPER_MENU_ID, MENU_NM, MENU_URL FROM TB_MENU ORDER BY MENU_ORDR
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MENU (MENU_ID, UPPER_MENU_ID, MENU_NM, MENU_URL, MENU_ORDR) VALUES (#{menuId}, #{upperMenuId}, #{menuNm}, #{menuUrl}, #{menuOrdr})
mapper.select: SELECT C.CODE_ID, C.CODE_NM, D.CODE, D.CODE_NM FROM TB_CODE C JOIN TB_CODE_DETAIL D ON C.CODE_ID = D.CODE_ID
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_CODE_DETAIL T USING (SELECT #{codeId} CODE_ID, #{code} CODE FROM DUAL) S ON (T.CODE_ID = S.CODE_ID AND T.CODE = S.CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.CODE_NM = #{codeNm} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CODE_ID, CODE, CODE_NM) VALUES (S.CODE_ID, S.CODE, #{codeNm})
mapper.select: SELECT A.ADMIN_ID, A.ADMIN_NM, H.AUTH_NM FROM TB_ADMIN A JOIN TB_AUTH H ON A.AUTH_CD = H.AUTH_CD
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ADMIN SET AUTH_CD = #{authCd} WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId}
mapper.select: SELECT LOG_SN, ADMIN_ID, LOGIN_DT, IP FROM TB_LOGIN_LOG WHERE LOGIN_DT >= #{fromDt} ORDER BY LOG_SN DESC
